long_biography.plain_text:
Jayant Ganwani’s operating philosophy at Lals Group is to treat every retail brand like a child: each needs time, capital and opportunity before it can succeed. He studied management and international business at New York University, then moved through finance and operations roles after joining the family enterprise.

Ganwani has worked to separate family ownership from professional management, reserving strategic decisions for the owners while delegating day-to-day authority. When physical retailers lost ground during the pandemic, he acknowledged that Lals Group had adopted online selling too slowly. He then oversaw an eight-month effort to put every business online, including the testing needed to make each platform work.
